name: fromscratch-studio
description: Backend-free visual OS learning studio with browser compilation, v86 and x86_64 QEMU-Wasm runners.

scripts.kill: pkill -f "vite --host 0.0.0.0" || true; pkill -f "python3 -m http.server" || true; pkill -f "node .*vite" || true; echo "FromScratch servers stopped."
